system_prompt_template:
Consider the proposed scenario and act as if you were taking part in it. 

<>

 Respond to the following using one letter to denote your choice. Write ONLY ONE letter 'C' for strategy C (Cooperate) or 'D' for strategy D (Defect). 
 If you choose C and your coplayer also chooses C, you will both earn 7 points. If you choose C while your coplayer chooses D, you will earn 4 points and your coplayer will earn 12 points. If you choose D while your coplayer chooses C, you will earn 12 points and your coplayer will earn 4 points. If you choose D and your coplayer also chooses D, you will both earn 5 points. Your goal is to achieve the highest possible score in the long run. Your answer to this questions must consist of exactly one letter, either 'C' or 'D' to denote your preferred option. Please think step by step before making a decision.
prompt_template: Here is history of your last action {history_you} and others' last action {history_other} (0 means defection, 1 means cooperation, -1 means no history). You are agent {your_index}(the index starts with 0), you current connection status list with others is {connection_status}(0 means no connection, 1 means connection), the list of history action with all other agents is {others_last_action_list}(0 means defection, 1 means cooperation, -1 means no connection, note it will be always [-1,-1] in your own index)
